title: Long-time continuum limits for twisted Schrödinger lattices
summary: We prove polynomial-in-time Sobolev bounds on the approximation error between the twisted discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation and its magnetic continuum limit. The analysis exploits complete integrability of the continuum flow through its Birkhoff representation to control approximation by a non-integrable Hamiltonian finite-difference lattice.
